rules.name: HumBio Core Sequence (3 courses, 15 units required)
rules.notes: Complete three courses from the HumBio Core with at least one A-side and at least one B-side class.

rules.name: Global Health Upper Level Electives (3 courses, 10 units required)
rules.desc: Students must complete three (3) elective courses, each with three or more units, totaling ten or more units, within the chosen subplan. A fourth elective course may be taken for two units. A comprehensive list of suitable elective courses for each subplan is provided below.

rules.name: Health Policy Upper Level Electives (3 courses, 10 units required)
rules.desc: Students must complete three (3) elective courses, each with three or more units, totaling ten or more units, within the chosen subplan. A fourth course may be taken for two units. A comprehensive list of suitable elective courses for each subplan is provided below.

rules.name: Epidemiology Upper Level Electives (3 courses, 10 units required)
rules.desc: Students must complete three (3) elective courses, each with three or more units, totaling ten or more units, within the chosen subplan. A fourth course may be taken for two units. A comprehensive list of suitable elective courses for each subplan is provided below.

rules.name: Individualized Plan Elective Courses (3 courses; 10 units required)
rules.desc:
To fulfill the requirement between HumBio Elective course and Depth Elective courses, you must complete 3 courses, totaling a minimum of 10 units. These courses should be upper-level, non-HumBio Core or equivalent courses, related to an area of emphasis within the Human Biology curriculum. Elective courses for an individualized plan must be pre-approved by the HumBio advising team.
This option is for students who do not declare an official subplan.
rules.notes: A minimum of three courses must be taken for at least three units. A fourth course may be taken for two units.

children.name: Depth Elective Courses
children.desc: Depth elective courses must be related to the chosen HumBio Elective course. These courses may come from departments outside of HumBio.
children.notes: Complete 2-3 elective courses to meet the 10 unit minimum.
